title: WaterColor 70 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 9 wristbands.- 4 adult bikes- Furnished porch- Gas Grill & Green Egg- Free WiFi- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: 70 Red Cedar Way is the epitome of a luxurious beach cottage. With 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, gorgeous screened porches, and spacious accommodations for 8 guests, this perfectly-appointed WaterColor retreat welcomes you to 30A with class and impeccable style.The home's screened front porch and modern black-frame windows set the stunning scene for your ultimate WaterColor vacation. Inside, high vaulted ceilings allow natural light to fill the main living area, and the open-concept floorplan invites guests to share in a time of togetherness and fun. The living room showcases a gorgeous collection of coastal decor and art and beckons guests to relax on the plush, oversize sectional sofa. A large flat-screen television creates the perfect opportunity to enjoy a family movie night at the end of a long day of fun and sun.Home cooks will love this well-equipped kitchen. Premium stainless steel appliances, bright white cabinetry, and spacious granite countertops allow families to enjoy preparing meals together. The nearby dining area offers six beautiful rattan chairs, with seating for an additional two guests at the adjacent breakfast bar. Down the hall are two of the home's beautiful bedrooms. Guests in the king bed guestroom will enjoy a plush upholstered bed, a large flat-screen television, and a shared bathroom with a shower and single vanity. The gorgeous primary suite presents a regal king bed and a private en suite bathroom with a shower, a separate spa tub, and a dual-sink vanity. Guests in this suite will enjoy the French doors to access the screened porch. The second level offers two beautiful bedrooms - a king bed guestroom and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo, and a bunk room with two twin beds.The spacious screened porches offer lots of lovely seating options and the perfect place to enjoy an invigorating morning sunrise with a cup of coffee or a breathtaking sunset with an evening cocktail. Perfectly situated in WaterColor's tranquil and much-desired Camp District, this home offers guests the quiet respite they so desire from everyday life.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 9):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with ShowerSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin Beds Weddings are not allowed at this home.
